Geo-handler (GH)
Geo-handler (GH) is a module responsible for routing features based on the user's geographical location, ensuring features are applied according to local regulations.

NetChoice v. Utah
NetChoice v. Utah refers to the legal case involving a challenge to the enforceability of the Utah Social Media Regulation Act, with ongoing litigation affecting the law's implementation.

Age-sensitive Logic (ASL)
Age-sensitive logic (ASL) is a method used to detect minor accounts by verifying user ages through specific criteria.

10th Circuit
The 10th Circuit is the court to which the appeal of the Utah Social Media Regulation Act was filed, impacting the future of the law's enforcement.

Utah Social Media Regulation Act
The Utah Social Media Regulation Act (S.B. 152 and H.B. 311) imposes requirements on social networks in Utah, including age verification and parental consent for minor accounts.

Curfew Login Blocker
The Curfew Login Blocker is a feature that restricts login access for minors under 18 in Utah, implementing age-sensitive logic and geo-routing to enforce compliance with local regulations.

data.content:
Utah Social Media Regulation Act (S.B. 152 and H.B. 311)
The Utah Social Media Regulation Act (S.B. 152 and H.B. 311) establishes obligations for social networks operating in Utah, including age verification, parental consent, and access requirements for minor accounts.

Appellate Review
Appellate Review refers to the ongoing review process related to the appeal made to the 10th Circuit concerning the Utah Social Media Regulation Act.

Age Verification Requirement
Age Verification Requirement specifies that social networks must verify the age of all users in Utah to maintain compliance with the local social media regulation.

Preliminary Injunction
The Preliminary Injunction issued on September 10, 2024, currently prevents enforcement of the Utah Social Media Regulation Act pending litigation.

Utah
Utah is a state in the United States where the Curfew Login Blocker is implemented specifically for users under 18, as per local regulations.
